column1: # Scope: titles in the information panel for every item, building and tile/engraving sheet in the installed Windows game.
# Native executable PE:6a70a6d9:02711000. Addresses below come from static disassembly, not observations of a running game.
# Infinite material/name/quantity combinations are represented by their native production and shared typed grammar; user-authored names retain their text.
# Caption precedence: complete material/item/building/terrain productions outrank strict native-item-name fallback. A bare title is never evidence for the broad prose artifact-name parser.

# Whole-title ownership is attached to the five verified native draw callers before generic grid fragments: Item, Building, Engraving, Terrain and PlannedEngraving. Captured complete sources retain nickname spacing, CJK and clipped tails; authored building names and active edits retain their original text.

# Runtime title dispatch: src/fortress_item_captions.inc::translate_info_panel_title. Building uses ::map_hover::building and the stockpile resolver; terrain uses translate_tile_description; planned engraving binds the existing Engraving {tiles} production after translating its complete terrain field.
